notes: Business is 97.98% 3C hardware. Creator laptops and creator-segment motherboards are mentioned without revenue, so they stay below level 4. Gaming hardware and eSports-promotion subsidiaries were not counted as creative work. E9 (indigenous project) is a named sub-project of the broader refurbished-computer program (E6); E9 is cited only for cross-cultural to limit overlap, but the 200,000 person-times figure in E6 may include it. The Digital Opportunity Center's 2009-2014 APEC phase is past; only the ongoing TDOC/Digital Cultivation work was scored. Hua-Cheng Venture Capital invests in computer peripheral businesses and is not described as a founder-enabling program. 'Weaponization of generative AI' is a cybersecurity phrase, not a weapons flag. Many Community and Cross-cultural activities are run through the ASUS Foundation, which the company funds by board-approved donation.
